menu.reports:
📊 Reports
 Sales and trends at a tap.
 • Product report — example: "{0} ka report"
 • Record an expense: "expense 500 packaging"
 • profit / profit today
 • sales by category [this week] — sales by category
 • margin — how much discount each product can take
 • business audit — a quick look at the shop's health
 • ask a question: "most expensive product", "which customers have not come back"
 • export orders 30 days
